spans.s: + धव मेना- + धव, m. Himālaya, the personified mountain.
मेनका, i. e. मेना + क, f. One of the courtesans of heaven, and wife to Himālaya, Śiś. 9, 86; Śāk. 14, 23 (Prākṛ.).
मेना, f. One of the courtesans of heaven, and wife to Himālaya,

मे-नाद (मे, an imitative sound), m.
 1. A cat.
 2. A goat.
 3. A peacock.
